entries.title: Psalms 129:1
segments: My youth; the youth of the nation.

entries.title: Psalms 129:2
segments: The history of God's church from the beginning is a continuous fulfilment of the primitive prophecy, "It shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel."  She is always afflicted by her enemies, and always prevailing against them.

entries.title: Psalms 129:3
segments: Ploughed upon my back; furrowed my back with stripes.

entries.title: Psalms 129:4
segments: The cords of the wicked; the cords with which the wicked, the enemies of Israel, bound him.  The figure in this and the preceding verse is that if a captive bound and scourged.

entries.title: Psalms 129:6
segments: Upon the house-tops; the flat roofs, which in the East are often covered with earth.

Afore it groweth up; or, afore one plucks it; before it is fit to be gathered for use. 
 
The prosperity of the enemies of God's people is always short-lived.

entries.title: Psalms 129:8
segments: Say; to the reapers, according to the custom of the age.  See
